newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom says no plan to sell stake.
newsitem.headline: Telkom says no plan to sell stake.

text.p: Indonesian telecommunications giant PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) said on Thursday that the company has no plans to sell a stake to Singapore Telecom.
"From the company's side, we have no plan to sell a stake to Singapore Telecom," Thomas Widjanarto, the head of Telkom's investor relations unit, told Reuters.
At 0410 GMT, Telkom was up 100 rupiah to 4,000 rupiah on a volume of 1.5 million shares after rising to 4,050 rupiah earlier on talk of the stake sale.

Brokers also attributed the rise in Telkom to reports that its subsidiary cellular operator Telkomsel planned to float shares later this year coupled with expectations Telkom will announce good first quarter results on Friday.
